papers.title: StopWatch: Goal Grounding for Object-goal Navigation
papers.abstract: Pretrained VLMs bring rich world knowledge and semantic priors to object-goal navigation, and fine-tuning a VLM into a navigation policy has become a common recipe. Despite this progress, success rates remain low, and it is unclear which capability these fine-tuned policies lack. Our diagnosis identifies goal grounding as the dominant failure. These policies explore well, yet often fail to notice that the goal is already in view or to estimate how far away it is. To address this failure, we ground the goal explicitly. Explicit grounding substantially improves success and reaches state-of-the-art results on six benchmarks across three scene collections. We also correct annotation defects in these benchmarks, so that future methods are evaluated more faithfully. Our analysis on the clean benchmarks shows that, with ground-truth grounding, our policy nearly matches the expert that generated its demonstrations, leaving the headroom in perception rather than policy learning. Our work points to goal grounding as a missing piece of object-goal navigation and offers a simple and effective solution to the task.

ai_summary.problem: 预训练 VLM 微调得到的物体目标导航策略成功率仍低，论文诊断出主要失败原因是“目标接地”不足：策略会探索，但常未注意到目标已在视野中或无法估计目标距离。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出显式目标接地（goal grounding），让导航策略明确判断目标是否可见并估计其距离/位置，从而改进基于 VLM 的物体目标导航策略；同时修正了相关基准中的标注缺陷。
ai_summary.result: 显式接地显著提升成功率，在三个场景集合的六个基准上达到 SOTA；在修正后的干净基准上，使用真值接地时策略几乎追平生成示范的专家，说明剩余瓶颈主要在感知而非策略学习。
ai_summary.novelty: 把目标接地识别为物体目标导航的关键缺失环节，并给出简单有效的显式接地方案及基准标注修正。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 VLM/具身导航研究指出感知层面的目标接地瓶颈，强调显式空间与目标定位对可靠导航策略的重要性。
ai_summary.org: UC Berkeley（根据作者 Pieter Abbeel 等推断）

papers.title: Persistent Planar Memory for Video World Models
papers.abstract: Video world models that generate and explore environments at scale need a persistent 3D memory of what they have produced. Plane primitives offer a natural candidate: a compact set of oriented planes captures the dominant structural elements (e.g., walls, floors, facades) of indoor and outdoor scenes, while requiring only 7 parameters per primitive. We present PPMem, a video world model that adopts plane primitives as its persistent 3D memory. PPMem augments a video diffusion transformer with a planar prediction head and a Depth Token Fusion (DTF) module: each autoregressive chunk jointly produces RGB video and planar geometry, which merges into a persistent plane memory that conditions subsequent chunks via rendered depth. The resulting memory is three orders of magnitude more compact than per-pixel point clouds (~100K primitives, 5MB for a full scene), geometrically explicit (metric depth, normals, exportable surfaces), cross-view consistent (jointly predicted by the shared backbone), and adaptive (refined by the merging procedure as generation proceeds). On DL3DV and RealEstate10K, PPMem outperforms prior 3D-grounded world models in video quality while jointly producing metric-scale depth, surface normals, and exportable planar geometry, sustaining coherence across hundreds of frames under large viewpoint changes. Project page: https://hyzcluster.github.io/ppmem.

ai_summary.problem: 视频世界模型在生成和探索大范围环境时，需要持久的三维记忆来保持一致性和几何结构；逐像素点云记忆过于庞大。
ai_summary.method: PPMem 采用带方向的平面基元作为持久三维记忆，并在视频扩散 Transformer 中加入平面预测头和 Depth Token Fusion 模块。每个自回归视频块联合生成 RGB 视频与平面几何，合并为持久平面记忆，并通过渲染深度条件化后续生成。
ai_summary.result: 在 DL3DV 和 RealEstate10K 上，PPMem 的视频质量优于已有 3D-grounded 世界模型，同时输出米制深度、表面法线和可导出平面几何，并在大视角变化下保持数百帧连贯。完整场景记忆约 10 万个基元、5MB，比逐像素点云紧凑约三个数量级。
ai_summary.novelty: 将平面基元作为视频世界模型的紧凑、显式、跨视角一致且可迭代精化的持久三维记忆，并与视频扩散生成联合建模。
ai_summary.relevance: 为长时程、可扩展且具备显式几何一致性的视频世界模型提供了一种高效记忆表示。
ai_summary.org: 清华大学（Yong-Jin Liu 等）；部分作者机构未在提供信息中明确列出

papers.title: Momentum: Persistent Dynamics for Video World Models
papers.abstract: Video world models must capture how a scene evolves beyond the current camera view to generate consistent observations when its content reappears. Existing approaches rely on observation history, static point clouds, or image caches constructed from past frames. These representations are often expensive and, more importantly, cannot update dynamic scene content outside the field of view: generated vehicles and pedestrians may be forgotten after leaving the field of view or reappear in physically inaccurate states. We represent an evolving scene through synchronized videos from reference-camera rigs, each comprising eight cameras that jointly cover the surrounding scene. We connect these rigs in a graph and propagate video generation between neighboring rigs to coordinate scene dynamics across locations and time. We introduce Momentum, a two-stage pipeline: WorldUpdate jointly generates reference-camera videos as a shared memory of scene dynamics, and WorldInteract grounds camera-controlled video generation in this evolving memory, allowing moving content to remain represented outside the target view and reappear consistently. To support training and evaluation, we develop a CARLA pipeline that captures synchronized videos from reference camera rigs and a moving target camera, together with an evaluation framework measuring consistency within the generated world state and the target observations.Experiments on generated street scenes show that grounding target videos in scene dynamics generated by Momentum improves dynamic scene consistency by 126.2% in unseen scenes over static image conditioning, while also improving visual fidelity. Our models and source code will be made publicly available.

ai_summary.problem: 视频世界模型难以在相机视野外持续维护动态场景内容，导致生成物体离开视野后被遗忘或再次出现时物理状态不一致；现有基于历史、点云或图像缓存的方法昂贵且无法更新视野外动态。
ai_summary.method: 论文用由8个相机组成的参考相机组同步视频表示演化场景，并将多个相机组连成图，在相邻组间传播视频生成以协调跨地点、跨时间的场景动态。提出两阶段流程 Momentum：WorldUpdate 联合生成参考相机视频作为场景动态共享记忆，WorldInteract 以该动态记忆为条件进行相机控制视频生成。
ai_summary.result: 在生成街景实验中，相比静态图像条件，Momentum 在未见场景中将动态场景一致性提升126.2%，同时提升视觉保真度；作者还构建了基于CARLA的同步数据采集与一致性评测框架。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用图连接的参考相机组同步视频作为可持续更新、覆盖目标视野外的场景动态记忆，并以此驱动目标相机视频生成。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视频世界模型提供了面向持久动态场景表示、跨视野一致生成与系统评测的新范式，有助于推动可交互、长期一致的世界模型发展。

papers.title: Beyond Large Language Models: A Mental World Model Framework for Mental Modeling, Simulation, Evolution, and Interpretability
papers.abstract: Understanding and simulating how subjective cognition and mental states emerge, evolve, and shape behavior is essential for advancing artificial intelligence toward deeper social cognition and general intelligence. Existing large language models (LLMs) and Theory of Mind (ToM) methods primarily infer mental states from linguistic information, lacking unified mechanisms for subjective world construction, cognitive-psychological interactions, dynamic evolution, and historical dependencies. This paper introduces the Mental World Model (MWM) and its implementation, the Multi-Branch Mental Evolution Architecture (MMEA), which explicitly constructs subjective worlds, models interactions between cognition and mental states, and simulates continuous mental evolution shaped by historical experiences. On DynToM and RecToM, MMEA achieves 96.48% and 94.00% accuracy, respectively, outperforming leading LLMs and specialized ToM methods. Additional experiments demonstrate improvements of 28.7, 39.3, and 16.6 percentage points in mental state and behavior prediction, long-sequence prediction, and implicit mental state inference, respectively. The results demonstrate that MMEA provides an interpretable framework for continuous mental modeling, enabling AI to move beyond surface-level semantic representations to infer individuals' underlying mental states from linguistic information and dynamically simulate their internal cognitive processes and evolution over time. MWM also provides a promising foundation for causal reasoning, personalized AI, sustained human-AI interaction, and future advances toward artificial general intelligence (AGI).

ai_summary.problem: 现有大语言模型和心智理论方法主要从语言信息推断心理状态，缺乏统一机制来构建主观世界、建模认知与心理状态交互、动态演化及历史依赖。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出心理世界模型（MWM）及其实现多分支心理演化架构（MMEA），显式构建主观世界，建模认知与心理状态之间的交互，并模拟由历史经验塑造的连续心理演化过程。
ai_summary.result: MMEA在DynToM和RecToM上分别达到96.48%和94.00%准确率，超过领先LLM和专用ToM方法；并在心理状态与行为预测、长序列预测、隐式心理状态推断上分别提升28.7、39.3和16.6个百分点。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是提出可解释的心理世界模型框架，将主观世界构建、认知-心理交互、历史依赖和连续心理演化统一建模。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作推动AI从表层语义表示走向对个体潜在心理状态和内部认知过程的动态模拟，为因果推理、个性化AI、持续人机交互及AGI研究提供新基础。

papers.title: FedRAPP: Federated Test-Time Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models with Reliability-Aware Prompt Personalization
papers.abstract: Federated prompt learning enables vision-language models like CLIP to collaboratively adapt lightweight soft prompts across distributed clients without sharing raw data. However, existing federated prompt learning methods are designed primarily for supervised settings with labeled client data and assumed relatively stable training distributions. At test time, source-free federated prompt tuning remains largely unexplored. Clients may receive unlabeled target samples with heterogeneous, often non-IID distributions that differ substantially across clients and from the source training distribution, causing locally adapted prompts to drift in different directions and reducing the effectiveness of federated aggregation. In this work, we explore Source-Free Federated Test-Time Prompt Tuning (SF-FTTPT), where distributed clients collaboratively adapt soft prompts on unlabeled test streams without access to source data. Our study reveals that conventional federated aggregation methods struggle under heterogeneous client distributions, as locally adapted prompts become increasingly specialized and difficult to combine effectively. To address this challenge, we propose FedRAPP, a personalized aggregation framework that combines reliability-aware client assessment, server-side exponential moving-average prompt memory, and similarity-guided peer aggregation. FedRAPP selectively incorporates information from reliable and compatible clients while preserving local specialization, enabling more robust adaptation under distribution shift. Extensive experiments across nine CLIP benchmark datasets and ImageNet variants demonstrate that FedRAPP consistently outperforms standard federated aggregation baselines under heterogeneous client distributions while maintaining the efficiency advantages of prompt-only adaptation.

ai_summary.problem: 现有联邦提示学习主要依赖有标签且分布较稳定的客户端数据，缺少在无源数据、无标签且客户端分布异构场景下的联邦测试时提示调优方法；局部适配提示易发生漂移，导致传统联邦聚合失效。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出FedRAPP框架，在无源联邦测试时提示调优中结合可靠性感知的客户端评估、服务器端指数移动平均提示记忆，以及基于相似度的同伴聚合；有选择地融合可靠且兼容客户端的信息，同时保留本地个性化适配。
ai_summary.result: 在9个CLIP基准数据集和ImageNet变体上的实验表明，FedRAPP在异构客户端分布下持续优于标准联邦聚合基线，并保持仅提示适配的效率优势。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统探索无源联邦测试时提示调优，并提出可靠性感知与相似度引导的个性化联邦聚合机制。
ai_summary.relevance: 为分布式视觉语言模型在无标签、非独立同分布测试流中的隐私保护自适应提供了新思路。

papers.title: A Language-Informed Loss for Visual Generation
papers.abstract: End-to-end visual generation with pixel-space loss has recently achieved competitive performance without the need for learned image tokenizers. In this work, we study whether language-informed supervision can provide a richer training signal than pixel loss for visual generation. We introduce LILIE (pronounced "lily"), a Language-Informed and Lossless Image Encoder. LILIE is an invertible image transform trained such that a vision-language model can recover captions from noised features. The encoder uses a normalizing flow transformer trained jointly with a vision-language model via next token prediction. We then use the encoder to extract a simple language-informed loss for text-to-image generation. We train JiT models with LILIE loss, reducing gFD by 14 points (66.84 $\to$ 53.01) against a pixel-only baseline on the GPIC dataset. Our code, encoders, and generative models are available at https://suchiragarwal.com/lilie.

ai_summary.problem: 研究像素空间端到端视觉生成中，语言监督能否比纯像素损失提供更丰富的训练信号。
ai_summary.method: 提出 LILIE，一个可逆图像编码器，用归一化流 Transformer 与视觉语言模型联合训练，使 VLM 能从加噪特征恢复标题；再用该编码器构造语言 informed 损失来训练文本到图像生成模型。
ai_summary.result: 在 GPIC 数据集上，使用 LILIE 损失训练 JiT 模型，相比仅像素损失基线将 gFD 从 66.84 降至 53.01，降低 14 点。
ai_summary.novelty: 将可逆图像编码器与视觉语言模型联合训练，从而为像素空间生成提供无损且语言-informed 的监督信号。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明语言监督可作为像素空间视觉生成的有效训练信号，为无需图像 tokenizer 的生成模型提供新思路。

papers.title: Beyond Action Prediction: Learning Search-Free Planning in Latent Space
papers.abstract: Latent world models learn action-conditioned state transitions in a compact representation space, providing a predictive model for visual planning and control. However, planning with these models typically requires costly test-time optimization over action sequences. We propose to replace this online search with a goal-conditioned inverse model that directly predicts actions from current and goal observations. A key challenge is that action prediction alone neither ensures that goal representations encode action-relevant information nor that predicted actions are consistent with the learned latent prediction model. We introduce Hindsight Inverse JEPA Planning (HIJP), a search-free framework that addresses both aspects during training. HIJP relabels future observations along offline trajectories as goals, providing action supervision across multiple temporal horizons. By retaining gradients through the goal representations, this supervision directly shapes the visual representation. HIJP further feeds predicted actions into the latent predictor model and aligns the resulting next-state representations with encoded successor observations, enforcing action-transition consistency. At inference time, the inverse dynamics model and latent predictor models are applied alternately to generate multi-step action sequences without online search. Across four visual control tasks, HIJP achieves 86.8% overall success and a 1.9-16.5x planning speedup over search-based planning.

ai_summary.problem: 潜在世界模型通常需要在测试时对动作序列进行昂贵的在线优化才能完成规划，论文旨在消除这一搜索过程并实现高效规划。
ai_summary.method: 提出HIJP框架，用目标条件逆模型直接从当前与目标观测预测动作；训练时将离线轨迹中的未来观测重标定为目标，并保留目标表示的梯度以塑造视觉表示，同时将预测动作输入潜在预测器，对齐下一状态表示与后继观测，保证动作-转移一致性。推理时交替使用逆模型和潜在预测器生成多步动作，无需在线搜索。
ai_summary.result: 在四个视觉控制任务上取得86.8%的整体成功率，相比基于搜索的规划实现1.9-16.5倍加速。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过事后逆目标监督与动作-转移一致性联合训练，将潜在世界模型规划转化为无需测试时搜索的目标条件动作生成。
ai_summary.relevance: 为潜在世界模型在视觉规划与控制中的高效部署提供了无需在线搜索的新思路，对世界模型和具身智能规划有参考价值。

papers.title: Not Every Mention Is a Claim: Rethinking Object Hallucination Detection in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Object hallucination in vision-language models (VLMs) is usually measured by checking each object a caption names against the image. Most benchmarks and detectors alike treat every object mention as a claim that the object is present. This assumption fails when a caption names an object without asserting it, as in "a bench for people to sit on", which mentions people without claiming that any are in the image. We call such mentions non-assertive. Treating them as hallucinations inflates the error rates attributed to models that use such language. To separate them from real hallucinations, we introduce NAME-Bench (Non-Assertive Mention Evaluation Benchmark), 25,497 object mentions from captions that five VLMs generate for COCO images. Each mention is labelled concrete (asserted and present), hallucinated (asserted and absent), or non-assertive, and non-assertive mentions are further divided into four subtypes: depictive, purpose, negation and hedged. All the hallucination detectors that we evaluate flag non-assertive mentions as hallucinations, at rates between 14% and 80%. Adding non-assertive mentions to detector training as negatives largely corrects this on LLaVA-1.5. On the four newer VLMs, a comparable correction takes five to ten times more data, and the detectors then catch fewer real hallucinations. These findings show that current detectors conflate mentioning an object with asserting it, and that this conflation is harder to undo on the four newer VLMs than on LLaVA-1.5. Hallucination evaluation should therefore separate what a caption asserts from what it merely mentions.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型的目标幻觉检测通常把标题中每个物体提及都当作“断言该物体存在”，但诸如“供人坐的长椅”这类非断言性提及会被误判为幻觉，从而高估模型的幻觉错误率。
ai_summary.method: 论文构建了 NAME-Bench，包含五个 VLM 为 COCO 图像生成的 25,497 个物体提及，并将每个提及标注为具体存在、幻觉或非断言性，非断言性又细分为描述性、目的性、否定和模糊限定四类；随后评估现有幻觉检测器，并尝试将非断言性提及作为负样本加入检测器训练。
ai_summary.result: 所有被评估的幻觉检测器都会把非断言性提及误判为幻觉，误报率在 14% 到 80% 之间；在 LLaVA-1.5 上加入非断言性负样本可大幅纠正该问题，但在四个较新 VLM 上需要多 5 到 10 倍的数据，且纠正后检测器捕获真实幻觉的能力下降。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统区分标题中“提及物体”与“断言物体存在”，并构建带细粒度非断言性标注的基准来重新审视目标幻觉检测。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作表明当前幻觉评估混淆了提及与断言，提示未来 VLM 幻觉评测应分离标题所断言的内容与仅仅提及的内容。

papers.title: Execution Before Memory: Diagnosing Memory Failures in Video World Models
papers.abstract: A memory test for a video world model should say whether the scene was set, whether the asked change was carried out, and whether the last frame shows the result. Current tests fold these into one number, so a low score is easy to read as forgetting. When the change is not carried out, the hidden state transition cannot appear, so the test is not really a test of memory. We introduce MIST, an evaluation that separates the change from the memory it should leave behind. The model first sets the scene while the change stays hidden, and only later is asked to show it, with leakage before that point kept under control. This separation locates the bottleneck: the model sets the scene but does not carry out the instructed change. The same gap appears in general memory evaluations. On that basis we propose M3-Agent (Make the Missing Move), which recursively revises the details of the input instruction so that the model successfully carries out the requested instruction. Relative to the baseline, it more than triples the MIST reveal score. On the benchmarks, WRBench's score T rises by 26.1% and MBench-T's score U by 52.7%. The method meets the problem from the execution side: it shows what the frozen model can do once the move is stated, and it sets a stricter baseline.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视频世界模型记忆评测将场景设置、指定变化执行和最终帧结果混为一个分数，低分容易被误读为记忆遗忘；需要区分“是否执行变化”与“是否记住变化”。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 MIST 评测：先在变化隐藏时设置场景，之后再要求模型显现变化，并控制提前泄漏，从而定位瓶颈。基于此提出 M3-Agent，通过递归修订输入指令细节，让冻结模型成功执行请求的变化。
ai_summary.result: 研究发现模型往往能设置场景但未执行指令变化；M3-Agent 使 MIST reveal score 提升三倍以上，并在 WRBench 上使 T 提升 26.1%，在 MBench-T 上使 U 提升 52.7%。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是将“执行失败”与“记忆失败”解耦，并从执行侧通过指令修订提升视频世界模型表现。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视频世界模型提供了更严格的记忆诊断评测和基线，避免把执行缺陷误判为记忆能力不足。
ai_summary.org: 论文未提供作者 affiliations；根据作者 Xihui Liu 推测可能主要来自香港大学（The University of Hong Kong）。

papers.title: ReVision: Reprogramming Image Generators for Dense Visual Perception
papers.abstract: Recent image generators exhibit rich visual priors that can support dense visual perception. However, existing approaches typically encode multiple perception tasks into a shared parameterization, making joint training sensitive to the mixture and weighting of heterogeneous data and prone to cross-task interference. To address this issue, we introduce ReVision, an instruction-conditioned parameter generation framework built on a frozen multimodal understanding model and a frozen image generator. Given an image and a free-form instruction, the understanding model jointly encodes them into a multimodal image--instruction representation, which a trainable parameter generator maps to transient low-rank updates for the generator. Each image--instruction pair induces a distinct set of transient prediction parameters, enabling instance-specific adaptation while both pretrained backbones remain unchanged. ReVision requires no task-specific heads, explicit task identifiers, or stored adapters. A shared RGB output interface unifies segmentation, depth estimation, and surface-normal prediction. Across diverse dense prediction benchmarks, ReVision achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods while supporting flexible task specification through natural-language instructions. Our analysis further reveals substantial gradient disagreement across tasks, highlighting the conflict introduced when heterogeneous objectives share a single parameterization. Meanwhile, the generated updates exhibit structured task- and input-dependent organization in weight space, further validating instance-level parameter generation for multi-task perception.

ai_summary.problem: 现有方法利用图像生成器的视觉先验做稠密视觉感知时，通常把多个感知任务编码进同一套共享参数中，导致联合训练对异构数据的混合比例与损失权重非常敏感，并且容易产生跨任务干扰。

papers.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, keeps the harness thin: it only turns the agent's commands into robot motion. The agent drives a robot with two arms through one command line. It sees three RGB cameras and knows their calibration. After each failed attempt, the agent reads the log, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools. In this way it keeps what it learns as code, as a coding agent does when it fixes a failing test. The tools may use only what the robot observes. They use triangulation to find where objects are, relative to each other and to the gripper. If two cameras see the same point, the point lies where the two camera rays meet. If a point lies on a known plane, such as the table or the top of a block, it lies where its ray meets that plane. When the head camera is not enough, the robot moves a wrist camera to get a second view. We build the tools on only ten layouts of one seed per task, then freeze them and test them on ten new layouts of the same seed. We use Codex with GPT-6-Astra at medium reasoning effort. On all 42 RoboDojo tasks, HexaShell reaches a success rate of 39.7% and a progress score of 48.0, averaged in the same way as the leaderboard. This is a new state of the art on RoboDojo. The limit is contact, not reasoning: pushing reaches 92.5% and memory tasks 65.0%, but tight insertion only 8.3%. When the agent fails, it usually sees the failure but cannot make the motion work. We open source the tools evolved so far at https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell.

ai_summary.problem: 探索基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的编码智能体在控制真实机器人时能走多远、又会在哪里受限，尤其是在多任务机器人操作中从失败中自我修复的能力边界。
ai_summary.method: 提出 HexaShell 薄封装系统，将智能体的命令行指令转换为双臂机器人动作；智能体使用三路 RGB 相机及标定信息，失败后读取日志定位原因，并编写或修复小型程序工具。工具通过三角测量和平面交会定位物体，必要时移动腕部相机获取第二视角；工具在每任务单一种子下的十个布局上构建后冻结，并在同种子新十布局上测试，使用 Codex 与 GPT-6-Astra 中等推理力度。
ai_summary.result: 在 RoboDojo 全部 42 个任务上达到 39.7% 成功率和 48.0 进度分数，取得新的 state of the art；瓶颈在接触控制而非推理，推动任务达 92.5%、记忆任务 65.0%，但紧插入仅 8.3%。
ai_summary.novelty: 以极薄 harness 让 VLM 编码智能体直接驱动机器人，并把失败经验沉淀为可复用、可演化的代码工具，形成类似修复测试的机器人编程闭环。

papers.title: When Evidence Vanishes: Distilling Visual-Evidence Dependency in Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Compact medical vision-language models (VLMs) can answer clinical questions correctly without reliably using the image, relying instead on question wording or learned priors. Standard knowledge distillation copies a teacher's answer preference on the original image, but it leaves unchecked whether that preference is conditional on the visual evidence required by the question. We study this missing target as medical visual evidence dependency: support for the correct answer should decrease when the matched evidence is absent. We introduce Evidence-Conditioned Dependency Distillation (ECDD), which pairs each training image with a control matched to the evidence level and distills the teacher's drop in answer margin across the pair. A lower bound objective transfers positive dependency by penalizing only shortfalls, while original-image supervision preserves task accuracy. The same formulation applies when the evidence is a queried clinical region, a surgical instrument, or whole-image visual content. Across three medical VQA settings, ECDD keeps original-image accuracy competitive with distillation and alignment baselines while making answer support more sensitive to evidence removal. Under the DME headline objective, for example, the positive-case margin response to target rather than random masking rises from 0.786 with KD to 2.023 with ECDD, while original-image accuracy differs by 0.11 points. These results suggest that medical VLM distillation should transfer both the teacher's answer preference and its dependence on visual evidence.

ai_summary.problem: 医学视觉语言模型可能答对临床问题却不真正依赖图像，而是依赖问题措辞或学到的先验；现有知识蒸馏只复制教师对原图的答案偏好，未检查该偏好是否依赖问题所需的视觉证据。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出证据条件依赖蒸馏（ECDD），为每张训练图像配一个与证据水平匹配的对照样本，并蒸馏教师在该图像对上的答案边际下降。方法用下界目标只惩罚依赖不足，同时保留原图监督以维持任务准确率，可适用于查询临床区域、手术器械或全图视觉内容等证据形式。
ai_summary.result: 在三个医学VQA设置中，ECDD在保持与原图蒸馏和对齐基线相当的准确率的同时，使答案支持度对证据移除更敏感。例如在DME主目标下，正例边际对目标掩码而非随机掩码的响应从KD的0.786升至ECDD的2.023，而原图准确率仅差0.11个百分点。

ai_summary.relevance: 有助于提升医学多模态模型蒸馏后的视觉 grounding 与可靠性，减少不依赖图像的虚假正确。

papers.title: HydraLLM: Adaptive Width Slicing for Elastic Text and Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: LLMs and LVLMs are increasingly deployed across heterogeneous hardware, ranging from data-center GPUs to resource-constrained edge devices. Their fixed-size architectures limit the ability to reuse a single model across deployment settings with different compute, latency, and model-size targets. We introduce HydraLLM, an elastic MQA-based architecture. Its number of active attention heads determines the effective widths of the embeddings, attention projections, feed-forward layers, and the output head, forming a nested family of subnetworks within a single parameter set. We introduce a static-to-elastic conversion pipeline that, starting from a pre-trained model checkpoint, includes importance-driven weight reordering and stochastic subnetwork training with knowledge distillation. We extend this principle to multimodal inference through an elastic projection module whose output width follows the active text width. HydraLLM covers a wider range of active parameter configurations than FFN-only elastic architectures. With 75% of heads active, HydraLLM achieves 2.2 percentage points higher TriviaQA accuracy than a state-of-the-art nested baseline configuration which has 17.25% more parameters. With 50% of heads active, our multimodal model achieves a CLIPScore comparable to that of the 7$\times$ larger Gemma 3 4B model. With only 25% of heads active, HydraLLM increases token-generation throughput by 75.3% over the full-width configuration.

ai_summary.problem: 大模型与多模态模型通常采用固定规模架构，难以在算力、延迟、模型大小各异的异构硬件（从数据中心 GPU 到边缘设备）上复用同一套权重，现有弹性架构（如仅对 FFN 做弹性）可覆盖的配置范围也有限。
ai_summary.method: 提出 HydraLLM，一种基于 MQA 的弹性架构：以激活的注意力头数量统一决定 embedding、注意力投影、FFN 与输出头的有效宽度，从而在单套参数内形成嵌套子网络族。配套给出从预训练 checkpoint 出发的 static-to-elastic 转换流水线，包含基于重要性的权重重排序和带知识蒸馏的随机子网络训练；并将该思想扩展到多模态，设计输出宽度随文本激活宽度变化的弹性投影模块。
ai_summary.result: 激活 75% 注意力头时，TriviaQA 准确率比参数量还多 17.25% 的 SOTA 嵌套基线高 2.2 个百分点；多模态模型在 50% 头激活下 CLIPScore 与 7 倍大的 Gemma 3 4B 相当；仅 25% 头激活时，token 生成吞吐比全宽配置提升 75.3%。
ai_summary.novelty: 用注意力头数量作为统一的宽度控制轴，使文本与视觉-语言模型的嵌入、注意力、FFN、输出头乃至多模态投影模块同步弹性伸缩，覆盖比仅 FFN 弹性更广的活跃参数配置空间。
ai_summary.relevance: 为“一套权重、多档算力”的弹性部署提供了可行方案，对边缘端多模态大模型的落地与推理成本控制具有实际价值。

papers.title: Synthetic Image Oversampling for Rare-Class Representation Learning in Deep Facial Phenotyping
papers.abstract: Recent deep facial phenotyping methods can support the recognition of genetic syndromes, but patient images are often scarce and unevenly distributed across disorders. Synthetic facial images offer a way to supplement the training data without collecting additional patient photographs. Their usefulness, however, depends on whether they improve recognition of real patients: generated images may introduce artifacts or repeat features already represented in the training set. It is therefore necessary to examine both how much synthetic augmentation to use and which disorders benefit. We investigate disease-specific synthetic oversampling using images from the Phenotypic Disease Image Database to augment a subset of the GestaltMatcher Database. We compare increasing augmentation levels in an image-based model, GestaltMatcher-Arc, and a multimodal model, GestaltMML, while keeping the real training and patient-disjoint evaluation partitions fixed. Repeated training runs assess overall and disease-specific accuracy, and an exploratory embedding analysis examines changes in class compactness and separation. Augmentation improves mean recognition accuracy in both training setups, although gains remain modest in GestaltMatcher-Arc and continue across the tested levels in GestaltMML. These aggregate improvements are accompanied by uneven disease-level responses, including reduced accuracy for some disorders. In the embedding analysis, disorders with fewer real training images tend to gain more class separation, but geometric changes do not consistently track classification performance. Together, the findings support synthetic oversampling for limited-data facial phenotyping and emphasize the need to assess its amount and benefit for individual disorders within each training setup.

ai_summary.problem: 遗传综合征面部表型识别中患者图像稀缺且类别分布不均，合成面部图像能否以及以何种程度补充训练数据、哪些疾病受益尚不明确。
ai_summary.method: 利用Phenotypic Disease Image Database中的疾病特异性合成图像对GestaltMatcher Database子集进行过采样增强，在固定真实训练集和患者不交叉评估集下，比较不同增强比例对图像模型GestaltMatcher-Arc和多模态模型GestaltMML的影响，并结合重复训练与嵌入空间分析评估总体/疾病级准确率及类内紧凑度和类间分离度。

papers.title: Expressivity of IQP Feature-Map Quantum Kernels via Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces
papers.abstract: Quantum kernels are among the most promising methods in quantum machine learning, providing a natural way to embed data into high-dimensional Hilbert spaces via quantum circuits and capturing non-linear relationships in data. Their learning behaviour is governed by the function class they represent, which is formally characterized by the structure of the associated Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS). However, a theoretical characterization of this function class, and of how it depends on the choice of feature map and its hyperparameters, is still lacking. In this work, we focus on the Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial (IQP) feature map and derive a Fourier representation of the associated RKHS generators as finite sums of trigonometric functions evaluated on polynomially transformed input variables, with a finite set of accessible frequencies determined by the circuit construction and scaled by the bandwidth hyperparameter. This representation identifies three bandwidth regimes with qualitatively distinct expressive properties from localised, through multimodal, to periodic. Numerical experiments on synthetic datasets with controlled periodic and multimodal structure, across data dimensions and feature-map configurations, reproduce the three regimes in both supervised classification and unsupervised anomaly detection, benchmarked against a classical Gaussian kernel. These results make the relationship between expressivity and data structure explicit for IQP kernels: expressive power translates into a practical benefit only when the accessible frequencies match with the structure of the data, which provides a criterion for selecting the bandwidth when the periodic or multimodal structure of data is known.

ai_summary.problem: 这篇论文要解决 IQP 量子核函数的函数类与表达能力缺乏理论刻画的问题，特别是其 RKHS 结构如何依赖特征映射及超参数。
ai_summary.method: 作者针对 Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial（IQP）特征映射，推导其 RKHS 生成函数的傅里叶表示：由多项式变换输入变量上的三角函数的有限和构成，可及频率由电路结构决定并受带宽超参数缩放。基于该表示识别出局部化、多模态和周期三类带宽区间，并在合成周期/多模态数据上做分类与异常检测实验，与经典高斯核对比。

ai_summary.novelty: 首次通过 RKHS 的傅里叶表示系统刻画 IQP 量子核的表达能力及其随带宽变化的三类区间，并明确频率匹配对实际性能的作用。
ai_summary.relevance: 为量子核方法中特征映射与带宽选择提供了理论依据，有助于理解量子核在结构化数据上的适用边界，但整体偏量子机器学习理论，对主流 AI 前沿的直接影响有限。

papers.title: Enhancing Visual Task-Redirection Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models via Closed-Loop Optimization
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable language-guided robot manipulation, but remain vulnerable to visual attacks that undermine user control over robot behavior. Prior studies optimize visual perturbations using fixed target supervision. However, the perturbation can change earlier actions and, in turn, the physical states reached later. As the attacked trajectory evolves, this supervision may no longer match the behavior needed at the states actually reached. Accurately matching these targets can therefore fail to advance the attacker-specified task. Even with suitable supervision, reducing average matching error does not ensure sustained task progress. The robot may still fail at a critical stage, and further updates can disrupt previously successful behavior. To address these limitations, we propose TRACO, a framework that enhances existing targeted visual attacks through closed-loop optimization. Its Execution-Driven Supervision rebuilds supervision for the states reached under attack to guide subsequent updates. Within this framework, Progress-Guided Selection focuses updates where progress stalls while maintaining supervision on the earlier behavior needed to reach that point. Experiments across VLA models and simulation environments show improved task-redirection success with TRACO, highlighting the security implications of closed-loop attack optimization.

ai_summary.problem: 现有针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的定向视觉攻击采用固定的目标监督信号，但视觉扰动会改变早期动作进而改变后续到达的物理状态，导致原监督与实际所达状态不匹配；即使平均匹配误差下降，也不能保证攻击者指定任务持续推进，机器人可能在关键阶段失败。
ai_summary.method: 提出 TRACO 闭环优化框架来增强已有的定向视觉攻击。其 Execution-Driven Supervision 根据攻击下实际到达的状态重建监督信号以指导后续更新；Progress-Guided Selection 则把更新集中在任务进展停滞处，同时保留到达该阶段所需的早期行为监督。
ai_summary.result: 在多种 VLA 模型和仿真环境中的实验表明，TRACO 提升了任务重定向攻击的成功率，说明闭环攻击优化会带来更严重的安全隐患。
ai_summary.novelty: 将视觉对抗攻击从固定目标监督转变为随攻击轨迹演化而自适应重建监督的闭环优化范式。
ai_summary.relevance: 揭示了具身智能与 VLA 系统在闭环执行下的新型安全脆弱性，为鲁棒性评估与防御设计提供了重要参考。

papers.title: FlexPart: Text-Controlled Semantics-Aware 3D Part Segmentation at Flexible Granularity
papers.abstract: A 3D asset admits multiple valid part decompositions, while semantics-aware segmentation should reflect both the desired granularity and the parts a user wants to extract. Ideally, a practical segmentation   model should strive for a simple principle: what you ask for is what you get. However, realizing this goal is hindered by two core obstacles: the lack of multi-granularity training data and the absence of a   holistic control mechanism. We propose FLEXPART, a unified framework for text-controlled 3D mesh segmentation. To establish flexible control, we introduce a holistic control prompt comprising semantic part   names with location and shape clauses. To support this mechanism, we utilize an automated Vision-Language Model (VLM) pipeline to construct a large-scale dataset of multi-granularity partitions and their   corresponding prompts. Driven by this data, FLEXPART generates a view-independent part-identity field in native 3D space, directly assigning discrete part IDs to mesh faces. To compel the model to respect   semantic conditions rather than rely on geometric priors, we train the model using randomized background dropping. Furthermore, an inference-time VLM planner can automatically complete descriptive clauses   from 2D renderings, allowing users to simply name the desired parts in ordinary words. FLEXPART with planner-completed prompts outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline by 15% in mIoU, even when that   baseline receives ground-truth guidance. On our held-out FLEXPARTBENCH, FLEXPART leads at each granularity and improves average mIoU by 22% over the strongest baseline. With only the requested part names   supplied by the user, it also improves IoU by 35% over the strongest click-driven baseline on selective segmentation.

papers.title: ADA 2025: A Multimodal Dataset for Water-Deficit Stress Detection in Sugar Beets
papers.abstract: Research and development into artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) applications in crop management are hindered by a lack of suitable public datasets. Whereas applications in disease and pest detection benefit from a comparatively higher amount of available data, applications like water-deficit stress detection often have very few if any public datasets available. Moreover, most datasets that are available are single-modality and frequently RGB-only, leaving the early detection and enhanced performance offered by other methods, and particularly by multimodal approaches, out of reach. Datasets with accurate metadata, higher numbers of plants, and smaller intervals between data points are also scarce. To address this, we publicly release ADA 2025, a >500 GB comprehensive multimodal dataset of young sugar beet plants under healthy and water-deficit conditions combining thermal, hyperspectral, RGB, and depth imagery along with relevant environmental and metadata and both relative water content (RWC) and leaf thickness as ground truth sources. Exemplary results showcase the dataset's validity in terms of differences detectable between stressed and healthy plants.

ai_summary.problem: 作物管理中AI/ML应用受限于缺乏合适的公开数据集，尤其是水分亏缺胁迫检测领域缺少多模态、含准确元数据和密集采样点的公开数据。
ai_summary.method: 公开释放ADA 2025数据集：>500 GB，包含健康与水分亏缺条件下幼年甜菜的热成像、高光谱、RGB、深度图像，以及环境/元数据和相对含水量（RWC）、叶片厚度 ground truth。
ai_summary.result: 示例结果展示了该数据集能够区分胁迫与健康植株，验证了数据有效性。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建了面向水分亏缺胁迫检测的综合性多模态甜菜数据集，融合多传感器、多 ground truth 与密集元数据。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态机器学习与精准农业中的胁迫早期检测提供了有价值的数据基础，但应用领域相对垂直。
ai_summary.org: Osnabrück University / DFKI（根据作者 Joachim Hertzberg 推断）

papers.title: Enhancing RAG-based Medical VQA with Gated Multimodal Representations
papers.abstract: Medical Vision-Language Models (Med-LVLMs) have shown strong performance in Medical Visual Question Answering (MVQA), yet they may still produce factually inconsistent responses. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can mitigate this issue by incorporating external clinical evidence; however, retrieval is often guided by a single modality, potentially overlooking the joint semantics of medical images and clinical questions. We introduce a multimodal RAG framework that learns a joint query representation through a Gated Multimodal Unit, enabling evidence retrieval to leverage information from both modalities while keeping the underlying Med-LVLM frozen. We evaluate the proposed approach on benchmark datasets. Results show that the multimodal query representation consistently outperforms a reference Med-LVLM and remains competitive with state-of-the-art methods. Our findings demonstrate the potential of multimodal query representations for more effective evidence retrieval in Medical VQA.

ai_summary.problem: 医学视觉问答中，Med-LVLM 仍可能生成事实不一致的回答；现有 RAG 方法通常只用单一模态引导检索，难以充分利用医学图像与临床问题的联合语义。
ai_summary.method: 提出一种多模态 RAG 框架，通过门控多模态单元学习图像与问题的联合查询表示，并用该表示检索外部临床证据；底层 Med-LVLM 保持冻结。
ai_summary.result: 在基准数据集上，多模态查询表示稳定优于参考 Med-LVLM，并与当前先进方法具有竞争力，说明联合多模态检索可提升医学 VQA 的证据检索效果。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用门控多模态单元构建联合查询表示来指导 RAG 检索，而非依赖单一模态查询。
ai_summary.relevance: 为医学多模态 RAG 中更有效的证据检索提供了轻量、可插拔的思路，对提升医学 VQA 事实性有参考价值。
ai_summary.org: 未提供（作者信息中未列出机构）

papers.title: MOSS: Multimodal Origami Swamp Robot System
papers.abstract: Robotic systems for environmental monitoring and ecological surveying in wetlands and swamps must operate across diverse terrestrial and aquatic conditions. Conventional fixed-geometry wheels cannot adapt their contact geometry to these varying conditions. This work presents MOSS (Multimodal Origami Swamp Robot System), a compact amphibious robotic platform with 3D-printed origami wheels. The compact crank mechanism switches the wheel between contracted and expanded configurations, changing its width, body diameter, and fin orientation simultaneously. The contracted configuration is better suited to efficient rolling on firmer ground, whereas the expanded configuration provides greater contact and terrain engagement on softer surfaces. MOSS was evaluated on soil, sand, mud with varying water content, and water, in addition to in-motion morphing and terrestrial-aquatic transition tests. The more energy-efficient wheel configuration depended on terrain. The contracted configuration achieved a lower cost of transport on firmer soil and mud, whereas the expanded configuration performed better on wetter mud, sand, and water, reducing the cost of transport by up to 29%. Expanded wheels also reduced slip in wet mud and reduced both slip and hub sinkage in sand. MOSS successfully completed configuration changes in $1.95 \pm 0.11$ s and demonstrated continuous locomotion across soil-mud-water transitions. Outdoor trials further demonstrated operation across natural deformable terrain and water. These results show that adaptive wheel geometry provides terrain-dependent locomotion benefits and enables a single compact platform to traverse substantially different terrestrial and aquatic conditions.

ai_summary.problem: 湿地与沼泽等环境同时包含硬地、软泥和水域，传统固定几何形状的车轮无法根据地形自适应改变接触几何，导致能耗高、打滑和下陷。
ai_summary.method: 作者设计了MOSS：一种紧凑的两栖机器人平台，配备3D打印折纸式车轮，通过曲柄机构在收缩态与展开态之间切换，同步改变轮宽、轮体直径和鳍片朝向；并在土壤、不同含水量的泥、沙和水面上开展能耗、打滑、下陷及运动切换实验。
ai_summary.result: 最优轮形态取决于地形：收缩态在较硬土壤和泥地上运输成本更低；展开态在湿泥、沙地和水面上更优，运输成本最多降低29%，并减少湿泥打滑及沙地打滑与轮毂下陷；形态切换耗时1.95±0.11秒，可连续跨越土—泥—水过渡，并在户外自然地形中完成验证。
ai_summary.novelty: 将折纸式可变几何车轮与紧凑曲柄驱动结合，用单一机构同步调节轮宽、直径与鳍片方向，实现跨陆水域的自适应运动。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作属于具身智能与机器人硬件层面，展示了形态自适应对复杂地形移动策略的价值，可为野外环境监测机器人与形态可变的具身系统设计提供参考，但与AI算法/模型研究关联较弱。
ai_summary.org: Imperial College London（推断，作者M. Kovac、S. F. Armanini等来自该校机器人实验室）

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日研究热点集中在多模态学习与世界模型，特别是视频世界模型中的持久记忆机制与规划能力，以及多模态大模型的鲁棒性评估与测试时自适应。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: 今日论文中未出现大厂（如Google、Microsoft、Meta等）的论文，因此无方向重合。研究主要由UC Berkeley、Stanford等高校主导，方向分散在多模态感知、世界模型构建与评估等方面。
daily_insight.signals: 值得关注的信号：世界模型领域出现多篇关于持久记忆与执行失败诊断的论文（如Persistent Planar Memory、Momentum、Execution Before Memory），表明记忆机制正成为视频世界模型的核心挑战；同时多模态幻觉检测与测试时提示调优受到关注，反映对模型可靠性的重视。
